correctness.rationale: The five cases hold with open neighborhoods and the whole cyclic vertex set as both sample ground set and center set, including radii above the diameter. In the complete case a two-point set cannot have an empty trace; at n=2r+2 an empty trace would require an antipodal pair, which has no singleton trace. At n=2r+3, multiplication by the inverse of r+1 converts complements to consecutive triples: a full three-point trace would require one such triple and its endpoints cannot occur without its midpoint. For n>=2r+3 the pair {0,r+1} has all four traces. In the four-point obstruction each membership bit has four change positions, with the two center-hole transitions consecutive. Sixteen different traces would force sixteen runs with precisely one changed bit at each boundary; the consecutive flips undo each other and repeat a trace in separate runs. At r=2, n>=9, requiring the full trace reduces the candidate triple to a subset of {-2,-1,1,2}; the witnesses for joint inclusion of the designated pair are confined to center 0, where the third vertex is also included. The wrap-around distances in the two uniform witness tables give their eight stated traces up to and including n=3r+2 and starting at n=3r+3, respectively; the C8 square witness checks directly. The fresh replay matched 297 pairs (3<=n<=24, 1<=r<=n) and the eight-trace witnesses on 295 pairs (3<=r<=12, 2r+4<=n<=5r+10). This is finite corroboration of the symbolic proof, not its basis.
residual_risks: No general assertion for closed neighborhoods or arbitrary circulants; bounded replay does not certify those or establish the unrestricted result.

value.rationale: A canonical graph family gives a complete exact benchmark for the effect of removing the center from a circular ball. In particular the square changes from three to two between n=8 and n=9, unlike the stable higher-radius regime. The center-hole argument explains an obstruction that the generic transition budget alone does not, and the exact witnesses distinguish every boundary without a cutoff.
residual_risks: The value is the exact classification for this family, not a claim about general graph learning bounds.
